hours: Monday-Friday: 10:00 AM-6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM-6:00 PM; Sunday: 11:00 AM-4:00 PM.
return_policy: Unopened books and gifts may be returned with a receipt within 14 days for store credit or a refund to the original payment method.
exchange_policy: Items may be exchanged within 14 days with a receipt. Exchanges for a different title are subject to current stock availability.
reward_rule: Earn one stamp with every book purchase. Fill your 10-stamp card and pick a reward at the counter: a free book, exclusive access, or a keepsake.
about_text: Riverside Books is an independent neighborhood bookstore on the riverfront. We carry new books, thoughtful gifts, and host friendly literary gatherings.
